## 1. Explicit circuit and resources
Let the base CSS code be ell-LDPC. Construct the alternating Tanner graph G on 2T+1 code layers with the usual alternating check vertices, leaving the two end DATA layers unmeasured. Each graph vertex has degree at most Delta<=ell+2. Let B be the measured bulk and ∂ the 2n boundary DATA vertices. Use one actual pointer R_v for each v in B.

Prepare graph vertices in |+> and pointers in |0>. Execute

 U = [parallel CNOT(v -> R_v), v in B]
     [parallel H_v, v in B]
     [product CZ_(uv), (u,v) in E(G)].

A greedy edge coloring uses <=2Delta-1 CZ layers; adding H and CNOT gives depth <=2Delta+1, independent of n,T. Gates have support<=2 and fixed graph-local degree. Space is O(ell nT), including pointers. Each gate can be run for a fixed O(1) physical duration with bounded Hamiltonian norm; that is a declared scheduled source, not an autonomous clock/compiler.

An arbitrary fixed-body perturbation conjugated by any partial ideal circuit has support in a constant-size backwards lightcone (conservative size <=q*2^(2Delta+1)) and bounded incident norm enlarged only by Delta-dependent constants. Intermediary partial gates need not be Clifford for this locality statement. The completed ideal circuit is Clifford.

After U, pointers may be dephased/read in Z and measured graph vertices discarded, but neither operation is needed for the source-span claim: retain both registers coherently and resolve the pointer computational components only in the analysis. No quantum feedforward is used in this circuit. Any further waiting/capture interval must be separately protected and is not silently included in its constant depth.

## Primary-source facts (compressed)
Bergamaschi–Liu, https://arxiv.org/html/2411.04405v1, sections 4–5: equations 21–23 cancel the raw outcome from corrected stabilizer signs. Definitions 18–20 give recovery depending on outcomes and repair depending on bulk error. The inferred bulk error has minimum weight at fixed metasyndrome. Equations 26–27 define the two mismatch graphs. Lemmas 5.2–5.4 prove componentwise minimum-weight comparisons and a boundary repair comparison; equations 32,39 give half-occupied bulk witnesses and quarter-occupied completed witnesses. Equation 44 gives zero syndrome for the collapsed operator of each nonbridging component. A component with nontrivial logical class must therefore have at least distance d vertices. Lemma 5.5 counts boundary-anchored unions, while Lemma 5.6 counts logical witnesses.

Caution: the sentence in Lemma 5.4 equating equal syndrome with stabilizer equivalence is too strong. Equal syndrome gives a normalizer difference; its minimum-weight argument needs only equal syndrome. Distance is used later to exclude a nontrivial logical class.

## 1. Fix the decoder before considering any noisy state
Use a fixed lexicographic tie rule for the minimum-weight bulk estimate beta(y), where y is ONLY the metasyndrome. It must not consult other raw outcome bits. Fix all subsequent minimum-weight boundary representatives similarly. Let M denote the binary metacheck matrix and let L collect the bulk X legs of a complete independent set of target Bell stabilizers. Let sigma denote their Pauli commutation vector on the two output blocks.
